## About
E&W Precision Roofing is a roofing contractor on Mountain Blvd in Warren, NJ. We replace and repair roofs, and we help homeowners put things back together after storm damage.
On a replacement, we walk the roof with you, go over material options, and show you a rendering of the house with your new shingle color before work starts. On install day the crew tears off the old roof, inspects the plywood and puts down ice and water shield, and your project manager stays on site.
Homeowners have given us a 4.9 rating from 36 Google reviews. Give us a call and we will come take a look at your roof.

## Services
- Roof replacement: Full tear-off of the old shingles, a plywood inspection, and ice and water shield before the new roof goes on.
- Roofing repair: Repairs for roofs that need work but not a full replacement.
- Storm damage: One customer said that after a storm we removed fallen trees and debris and repaired the holes in the roof, the main roof beam and the gutter system.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. One reviewer said his project manager walked the roof and worked with his insurance company to handle the process of a storm-related replacement.

Q: Can I see what my house will look like with a new roof?
A: Yes. One reviewer said that once he picked a shingle color, his project manager used the Hover app to show a rendition of the home with the new roof.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours, every day of the week.

## What customers say
- "Roof completed by E&W Precision Roofing yesterday...Back story: Subsequent to a storm event I noticed some shingles in my yard and some lifted shingles on my roof. Roof was in the neighborhood of 20 yrs old...I contacted our home owners insurance company to report it...The insurance company's field inspector took a look, and it was deemed that the roof qualified for a replacement through my insurance.

I was walking the dog one night and discussing my roof situation with my neighbor and he mentioned to me that he had the number of a project manager named Benjamin and they had worked together on a few roofing replacement projects, as my neighbor has a few investment properties...I reached out to Benjamin and he come to my home, walked the roof, and assured me he would be able to work with my insurance company to handle the process. Benjamin reviewed the different roofing material options with us and once we selected a shingle color, he used the Hover app to provide a rendition of what the home would look like with the new roof.

Materials for the roof were delivered the night ahead of the installation date. The day of installation the crew arrived around 8 am and started staging their tools and equipment. By around 10 am the old shingles were removed, the plywood inspection was complete, and the ice and water shield was being installed. The crew worked safely and efficiently.

The Owner of E&W (Wally) came by 3-4x during the day just to ask how things were going and if I was satisfied with the progress of the work. Benjamin, the project manager was there throughout. E&W was even accommodating when I made the request the day of the project to change the drip edge color from white to cream...Benjamin went to a local roofing supply house and got the color I wanted and came back quickly so as not to cause a hiccup in workflow for the crew.

I can't say enough with how impressed I was with the installation crew, the foreman "Flacco", and project manager (Ben). Very happy with the final product (Owens Corning Black Sable) and how it makes the house stand out from the adjacent homes on the block.

The roofing installation market is competitive. There are a bunch of contractors in the area, but I def recommend reaching out to E&W (Ask for Benjamin) if you are contemplating a roof replacement project or need a roofing repair. I found E&W to be competent as far as the installation, upfront when describing what to expect, and very tidy, leaving your home as it was prior to the work being completed." (Clayton Castle, 5/5)
